entries.5c5268f6697a9cc6: This business provides BtoB solutions for industries other than games. In addition to its core strategy consulting, it provides kitting BPO services, which cover installation and setup of PCs and other equipment and software through delivery, and supports clients one-stop from strategy formulation to execution. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥680 million. Consolidated subsidiaries Digon Co., Ltd. and Digon Consulting Co., Ltd. are mainly responsible for this business.
